answer: Triangulate by ping. Five verifiers spread across continents each time a nonce echo from every identity, and the round-trip times form a latency fingerprint of where it really runs. Fifty identities on one rack share one fingerprint, crowded like fish on a single reef, so they are paid as one miner. Faking spread means renting servers in many regions, which eats the jade a farm hoped to mine. Assumption: a shared VPN shifts every clone by the same offset, like one coat of umber over a wall, so they still match; co-hosted honest agents can appeal with proof of separate owners.
